tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `paper`, `warmpaper` and `washi` (14:1 or better in both themes). The logo file's own ink measures #070604.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: warmpaper
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and alternating sections on `paper`.

tokens.name: NHMred
tokens.usage: The deliberate accent: links, the one primary button (with `on-accent`), active states, the dot motif. As text only on `paper` and `warmpaper` (4.8:1+); not on `washi` (3.9:1). The logo file's dot measures #c80105.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `NHMred` fill (5.2:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: Slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `paper`, `warmpaper` and `washi` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: Hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between sections. Never the only edge of a control; use `border`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, meaningful dividers (3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: washi
tokens.usage: Cream stationery stock, sampled from the letterhead mockup and cleaned (approximate). Print, business cards, occasional feature panels. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Charcoal card stock, sampled from the dark business-card mockup and cleaned (approximate). Print and the dark theme's `warmpaper`. Same in both themes.

families.garamond: "Cormorant Garamond", Garamond, "EB Garamond", "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: wordmark-caps

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in `Slate` or `NHMred`.

styles.name: body
